elite: ELITE FY-4A/AGRI hourly seamless 4 km LST from Zenodo record 10595576; target-aligned 03:00 UTC extracted by HTTP Range from 202208.zip
ancfds: ANCFDS-LST 2022-08-24 hours 00-10 UTC; band 2 T_nadir is the canonical Stage-2 parent. These are the daylight/target-relevant hours used by SA-XGBoost; TPDC source is missing 16-22 UTC and no missing source hour is fabricated.
era5_land: hourly, used only to construct permitted dynamic energy factors
landsat: Landsat 8/9 C2 L2 raw-valid-pixel validation; QA mask is applied downstream
scaling_factors: 100 m terrain, WorldCover, Landsat spectral factors and MCD43A3 BSA/WSA
